name: user_service.py
summary: Encapsulates user domain business logic and orchestrates operations between User, Profile, and Dataset models.
purpose: To centralize user-related business rules and workflows, decoupling domain logic from presentation and data layers while coordinating cross-domain interactions with datasets.
responsibilities: Manage user lifecycle and business rules
Execute optimized database queries using Django ORM F expressions
Provide an abstraction layer for user domain operations
outputs: Operation status or aggregated user data
architecture_notes: Implements the Service Layer pattern to isolate domain logic from Django views and models. Imports F expressions indicating server-side computed updates or annotations. Cross-imports of the Dataset model suggest potential tight coupling between the users and datasets domains; consider whether this should be inverted or mediated via an application service or domain events to respect bounded context boundaries.
improvements: Introduce an abstract interface or protocol for UserService to improve testability and inversion of control
Decouple from the Dataset model by using a repository or application service to mediate cross-domain logic
Add comprehensive type hints and input validation
Document public methods with docstrings and establish a clear API contract
Evaluate if F-expression usage should be encapsulated within a repository or query object
